title: Keyboard only use and focus in a desktop app
when: Desktop users who never touch the mouse must reach every panel, list and dialog by keyboard with focus always visible.
prompt:
Goal: Every task in the window can be done by keyboard, focus moves predictably between panels and is always visible.
Steps:
1. Panels: F6 and Shift+F6 cycle focus between sidebar, list and editor; each panel is a landmark with a name.
2. Lists and trees use roving tabindex: the active item has tabindex="0", others "-1"; Arrow keys move, Home and End jump, Enter opens.
3. Dialogs use <dialog> with showModal(); focus goes to the first field, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener.
4. :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px } on every interactive element, with 3 to 1 contrast against the background.
5. Show shortcuts in tooltips and menus; Mod+/ opens a shortcut list.
6. Toolbars: one tab stop, arrows between buttons; icon buttons have aria-label.
7. Test: unplug the mouse and finish open, edit, save and settings; log any step that fails.
8. Check with the OS screen reader that each control reads name, role and state.
Quality bar:
- No keyboard trap anywhere.
- Focus never lands on a hidden element.
Pitfalls:
- tabindex values above 0, which scramble the order.
- Removing outlines because they look odd on click; use :focus-visible.
Verify:
- [ ] Focus styles exist for all controls.
- [ ] Dialogs restore focus on close.
- [ ] Keyboard test log covers the core tasks.
Output: focus.js, the focus CSS and a keyboard test log.

examples.input: usuário do meu app desktop usa só teclado e se perde
examples.output: F6 panel cycling, roving tabindex lists, dialog focus return, focus-visible ring, test log
